status: FROZEN exploratory hypothesis (post-hoc origin; NOT validated)
target: CPIN broiler segment margin = segment result / total broiler segment sales, standalone quarter, new (FY2020) basis

predictors.spread_q: mean over the 3 months of q of [PIHPS national producer 'Daging Ayam Ras Segar' (IDR/kg) - (0.55*WB CMO maize + 0.25*WB CMO soybean meal, USD/t) * monthly-average USD/IDR / 1000]

forecast_timing: day before CPIN's actual IDX filing for q (availability rule A-018); predictors must be published by then
benchmarks: mean: expanding mean of new-basis actuals known at forecast date
re_estimation: none (a, b fixed); benchmarks update with new actuals as they become available

evaluation.pass_rule: on n>=12 prospective quarters: MAE(H2) <= 0.85 x MAE of EACH benchmark AND Diebold-Mariano t (HAC, absolute loss) >= 1.65 vs the best benchmark
evaluation.kill_rule: fails pass_rule at n=12, or MAE(H2) > MAE(best benchmark) at the n=8 interim review
